574-2267-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Repeat.
574-2267-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

728-4381-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
728-4381-4694-7306.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

1479-2841-3318-3703.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1479-2841-3318-3703.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Sporemound and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sporemound trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2728-2921-6854-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-2921-6854-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-2921-6854-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 4.

676-813-1987.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
676-813-1987.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-813-1987.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
676-813-1987.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

Repeat from step 1.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Nightscape Familiar.
Repeat.

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability

Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.

Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

413-4740-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
413-4740-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying X life, where X is the creature's mana value.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.
413-4740-5220-6900.notes: Your starting life total will need to be at least a certain number depending on the mana value of the creature you are sacrificing to perform this combo. This list shows the minimum life total you would need to have, from mana value 1 (left) to 10 (right): 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, 22, 29, 37, 46, 56. You can also cast spells to reduce the needed life to start.

Repeat.
